://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/archive-an-environment.md): Archive an environment. It stops being selectable for ru
ns and frees its name for a new one, but the row is kept and can be restored — this is why archive is a sub-action rather than a D
ELETE. Requires `expectedRevision` — the revision you last read. If the environment changed since, the write is re…\n- [Restore an
archived environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/environments/restore-an-archived-environment.md): Restore an archived
environment. Returns 409 if another live environment took its name in the meantime. Plugin pins whose version row no longer exist
s at all are dropped on the way back to live — compare the returned `pluginVersionIds` against what you archived to detect that. R
equires `expectedRevi…\n- [List a project's scenarios](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-a-projects-scenarios.md)
: The studies published from this project — name, access mode, attached servers, and share link. Read-only.\n- [Publish an environ
ment for user testing](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/publish-an-environment-for-user-testing.md): PUT, not POST, b
ecause publishing is IDEMPOTENT: one study per environment, and publishing an already-published environment returns the existing o
ne rather than minting a second. `created` says which happened.\n- [Unpublish an environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referenc
e/studies/unpublish-an-environment.md): Takes the study down. Deliberately NOT behind the beta gate that guards publishing: an org
anization that loses the flag must still be able to take a live study down.\n- [Get a study](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference
/studies/get-a-study.md): One study's full read: execution settings (model, system prompt, tool-approval policy, attached servers,
share link), the environment it publishes, and the insights envelope over its latest analyzed window.\n- [Update a scenario](http
s://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/update-a-scenario.md): Change a study's identity or its exposure — but not both in one c
all. **Send `mode` on its own.** Identity and exposure are separate operations upstream, and applying them in sequence could leave
the study live in a mode you did not ask for.\n- [List a scenario's sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/list-
a-scenarios-sessions.md): What visitors did, as summaries. Project members only — this route is deliberately absent from the guest
allowlist, so a share-link visitor can never read other visitors' sessions.\n- [Get a session transcript](https://docs.mcpjam.com
/api-reference/studies/get-a-session-transcript.md): The projected transcript, paged. Tool payloads and blobs are dropped, and the
stored blob URL is never returned.\n- [Set the guest-execution caps](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/set-the-guest-
execution-caps.md): The spend dial for anonymous visitors. A FULL REPLACEMENT — send every field. These caps only mean something a
s a set, and a partial update that raised one while leaving another stale would produce a combination nobody chose.\n- [Rotate the
share link](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/rotate-the-share-link.md): Mints a new share link and stops the old URL
from granting access. Everyone you shared it with needs the new one.\n- [Invite a member](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/s
tudies/invite-a-member.md): Upsert by email, so re-inviting somebody is not an error. Only meaningful while `mode` is `invited_onl
y`.\n- [Remove a member](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/remove-a-member.md): Removal NARROWS access, so it bumps `a
ccessVersion` and cuts off any session that member already had — it takes effect at once rather than at expiry.\n- [Point a scenar
io at a different environment](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/point-a-scenario-at-a-different-environment.md): Keep
s the study's LINK, its members and its session history while changing what visitors actually reach. The alternative — unpublish a
nd republish — mints a new link, which means re-sharing it with everyone.\n- [Session metrics](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referen
ce/studies/session-metrics.md): Volumes, completion and feedback rates over the study's sessions.\n- [Usage breakdown](https://doc
s.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/usage-breakdown.md): Which models, tools and servers the study's sessions used.\n- [Current win
dow signals](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/current-window-signals.md): What the miner extracted from the current w
indow — and where you get the window id the insights read takes.\n- [List scenario findings](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference
/studies/list-scenario-findings.md): Every finding raised over this study's windows, dismissed ones included — dismissal is a stat
e on the finding, not a deletion.\n- [Read a window's insights](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/read-a-windows-insig
hts.md): Poll this after requesting a generation.\n- [Request insights for the current window](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referen
ce/studies/request-insights-for-the-current-window.md): **No credits are consumed** — the model cost is on MCPJam. Runs a model ov
er the study's current window and draws on the organization's `insightsPerDay` ledger, which counts REQUESTS and is SHARED with ev
al-run and swarm run insights, so a request here takes one from there.\n- [Cancel a window's generation](https://docs.mcpjam.com/a
pi-reference/studies/cancel-a-windows-generation.md): Releases a generation that is stuck `pending`. Idempotent against an already
-finished one.\n- [Dismiss a finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/dismiss-a-finding.md): Keyed on the finding's
stable remediation id, so the same problem stays dismissed when insights regenerate. Bodyless: the path names the finding.\n- [Res
tore a dismissed finding](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/studies/restore-a-dismissed-finding.md): Undoes a dismissal. Bodyl
ess: the path names the finding.\n- [Create (or revive) a relay tunnel for a named project server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-ref
erence/tunnels/create-or-revive-a-relay-tunnel-for-a-named-project-server.md): Registers a server record named `name` if missing,
mints a relay tunnel grant for it, and **persists the tunnel bearer URL (including the plaintext `?k=` secret) onto the server rec
ord's `url`** so evals and studies can target the tunnel like any remote server. The plaintext persistence is a deliber…\n- [Revok
e a tunnel's live grant](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/tunnels/revoke-a-tunnels-live-grant.md): Revokes the grant at the c
ontrol plane and edge: the public URL stops working immediately and any live tunnel session is disconnected. The server record — i
ncluding its now-dead `url` — is intentionally left untouched, so the next create revives the tunnel with the same slug.\n- [List
a project's plugins](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/plugins/list-a-projects-plugins.md): The live (installed, non-uninstall
ed) Agent Plugins in the project, disabled ones included (marked `enabled: false`). Read-only: import, activation, enable/disable
and uninstall are app flows, not API operations.\n- [Get a plugin version](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/plugins/get-a-plu
gin-version.md): One imported plugin version with its component projections: declared MCP servers (placement, auth timing, materia
lized server id) and declared skills (namespaced model refs). Addressed by the version id alone — access is membership of the vers
ion's own project, and historical versions of uninstalled…\n- [List a project's skills](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/skil
ls/list-a-projects-skills.md): The Cloud Skills visible to the caller in this project: the project-shared ones plus the caller's o
wn drafts. Each row reports `pinnability`, which is what decides whether its id is usable in an environment's `skillSelection`.\n-
[Get a skill](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/skills/get-a-skill.md): One skill, including its SKILL.md body. The body is m
utable and an edit overwrites the previous one in place, so `aggregateHash` is the only handle on which content this read returned
.\n- [Run one headless agent turn](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/agent/run-one-headless-agent-turn.md): Runs ONE assistant
turn over the supplied message history and responds synchronously with the final assistant text, the operations it invoked, refer
